title: What's New in Cinapse — November 2026
summary: Background Manager is the headline this month. It lets you budget background for every shoot day. This release also brings faster copy and paste, cleaner strips, and a long list of improvements.
body_markdown:
### Plan the crowd. See the cost.


Union and non-union headcount, hours, and estimated cost for every background group, with overtime flagged.


Background is one of the hardest lines in the budget to pin down. Headcounts move every time the schedule moves, and guild minimums and fringes differ by union and territory. Background Manager lets you plan, group, and budget background for every shoot day. Guild minimums for SAG-AFTRA, ACTRA, UBCP, and Equity are built in, and you set your own fringe rates on top.


Group background by scene and by type, like photo doubles, stand-ins, general background, and minors. For each group, set headcount, anticipated work hours, and paid hours by day. You can see costs for a day, a week, a block, or the whole shoot, and your background budget updates as the schedule moves. Available on Studio and Enterprise plans.


[Learn more about Background Manager →](https://www.cinapse.io/resources/introducing-background-manager)


### More Features. More Improvements.


**Faster copy and paste.** Copying elements between breakdown sheets is now fast, and pasted elements show up right away.


**Archived productions for the whole team.** Every member can now see archived productions, and only the owner can bring one back.


**Breakdowns and stripboard, in step.** When you step through scenes in schedule order from the breakdown sheet, the stripboard now moves to and highlights the same strip.


**Sync before you update.** When a new version is ready, Cinapse reminds you to let your changes finish syncing before you update.


**Back where you left off.** When your session ends, signing back in returns you to the page you were on.


**Clean strips from day one.** Default strip layouts now clip every cell to one line, so new productions start with a tidy board.


**One field picker for filters.** Filters and Advanced Search now share one picker, organized into breakdown fields, breakdown elements, and free text.


**Find & Replace, smarter defaults.** By default, Find & Replace ignores case and searches your stripboards, unscheduled strips, and scrapyard.


**Default roles, visible.** The Roles Manager lists your plan's default roles with a lock icon, so you can see exactly what Editor, Breakdown Editor, and Viewer can do.


**Bug fixes & stability.** Fixed sign-in loops when switching between Cinapse Beta and Cinapse, fixed a stripboard crash when a text field contained brackets, file ownership transfers now go through, subscription pauses take effect immediately, smoother color picking, and undoing a strip move now saves as expected.


It's all live. Log in and take a look. If you run into anything or have feedback, reach us atsupport@cinapse.io
